markdown:
This guide to the best forex brokers in Singapore compares **IG, Plus500, Interactive Brokers, Fusion Markets, Pepperstone, IC Markets, AvaTrade and BlackBull Markets**. Start with the actual company and its product permissions, not an advertised spread. Specific MAS directory leads are supplied for IG Asia and Interactive Brokers Singapore; the other brands require further entity checks.

Find the company in the [MAS Financial Institutions Directory](https://eservices.mas.gov.sg/fid/). An overseas group licence or a registration form does not establish a Singapore-regulated account.

## How we selected these brokers

The eight brands come from the supplied research, not live-account testing. We separate a named directory record from an unresolved international brand. This is not a ranking of eight MAS-licensed companies.

Use [MAS directories](https://www.mas.gov.sg/directories) and the [official FX overview](https://www.mas.gov.sg/development/foreign-exchange) to establish:

- The full company name and relevant licensed or exempt status.
- Product-specific permissions and retail customer eligibility.
- Whether the account offers currency conversion, CFDs or leveraged FX.
- Charges, deficit liability, client-money arrangements and complaints.

## Singapore CFD rules for retail traders

The brief cites a 5% margin from a [MAS policy response on margined derivatives](https://www.mas.gov.sg/-/media/MAS/News-and-Publications/Consultation-Papers/Response-to-Feedback-on-Proposed-Regulatory-Requirements-for-Unlisted-Margined-Derivatives-Offered-to-Retail-Investors.pdf). This page has not verified the current binding requirement for every product and customer class. Confirm it against the applicable rules and your company's schedule.

| Illustrative margin | Exposure/equity ratio | Interpretation |
|---|---|---|
| 5% | 20:1 | 1 divided by 0.05 |
| 10% | 10:1 | 1 divided by 0.10 |

These are mathematical examples, not verified current Singapore leverage ceilings. Margin is collateral, not maximum loss. Use our [position size calculator](/tools/forex-position-size-calculator) to plan cash risk separately.

## What “best forex brokers in Singapore” should mean

Prioritise an appropriate company, understandable product, complete costs and documented protections. Our [forex calculator](/tools/forex-calculator) and [profit calculator](/tools/forex-profit-calculator) help explore assumptions, not forecast profits. Use the [platform guide](/insights/best-platforms-for-day-trading) to assess usability.

## MAS protections explained

The brief includes a [2012 MAS consultation](https://www.mas.gov.sg/-/media/mas/resource/publications/consult_papers/2012/28-may-2012-review-of-regulatory-framework-for-unlisted-margined-derivatives.pdf). A historical proposal is not evidence of every rule currently in force. Check the [financial and margin requirements regulations](https://www.mas.gov.sg/regulation/regulations/securities-and-futures-financial-and-margin-requirements-for-holders-of-capital-markets-services-licences-regulations) and the applicable client agreement.

Ask about risk disclosures, liquidation, client-asset handling and deficit liability. This research does not establish a universal Singapore negative-balance guarantee; EU account protections should not be assumed.

## Investor protection: what it covers

| Check | Why it matters | What not to assume |
|---|---|---|
| Client-money handling | Establishes custody and account arrangements | Segregation eliminates every failure risk |
| Deficit liability | Determines responsibility after losses | Losses always stop at the deposit |
| Firm failure | Identifies complaint and recovery processes | MAS status insures trading losses |

No universal compensation limit or automatic failure payout is established here. Confirm the actual arrangements for the company and product.

## Payment methods in Singapore

Confirm bank transfer, FAST, card or e-wallet support directly; availability is company-specific. Check SGD conversion, fees, processing hours and the withdrawal route. Once eligibility is clear, consider a small test transaction; successful receipt does not guarantee future withdrawals.

## Red flags to avoid

- Missing company names or unverifiable MAS claims.
- Promised profits or pressure to deposit.
- Personal payment accounts or withdrawal-release charges.
- Claims that an overseas licence equals Singapore regulation.

## FAQs

### Is forex trading legal in Singapore?

The provider, product and customer class matter. Check relevant licensed or exempt status and permissions in the MAS directory. A working application or foreign group licence does not establish a suitable Singapore service route.

### Which forex broker is best for beginners in Singapore?

Start with verified company/product eligibility, then demo usability, education and complete fees. The supplied IG Asia and Interactive Brokers Singapore records are specific research leads; they do not guarantee every applicant or product is eligible.

### Is negative-balance protection the same as investor protection?

No. Contractual negative-balance protection concerns deficit liability. Other safeguards concern assets, conduct or firm failure. Neither means ordinary trading losses are insured; confirm the actual account terms.

## Final recommendation

Resolve the company and product permission first. Then practise with a demo, compare full costs and read liability terms. Treat the account-opening buttons as application links, not regulatory endorsements. Never trade money needed for essentials.
